title: Half-folded N11: the gallery retry budget is dead code — the stage machine still retries forever on unmet conditions
evidence: app/gallery.odin:57: `retries:  int, // N11: the condition-poll frame budget (GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES)` — repo-wide grep for `retries|GALLERY_MAX` matches ONLY this line (no constant, no read, no write). The stage machine still re-arms unbounded: `.Draw_Release:` `if !pipe_live(app) { gallery.wait = 5 // the commit lands via the executor — poll; return false }` and `.Noc:` `if !app.overlay_on || !app.stats_valid { ... gallery.wait = 5; return false }` (same at 251, 274, 284).
detail: The fix commit claims N1-N15 folded, but the N11 fold is a comment plus a never-read struct field. The unbounded-retry path (missed click, never-landing commit, stats never valid) hangs the capture run exactly as before.
recommended_fix: Define GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES; increment gallery.retries on each condition-poll re-arm and abort with the stage name when it exceeds the budget (reset on stage advance).

title: Audio seam refactor deleted rl.CloseAudioDevice() without a wrapper — the audio device is never closed in normal builds
evidence: diff hunk removes `-	rl.CloseAudioDevice()` from audio_destroy; the current body ends `if a.bed_on { audio_stop_music(a.bed); audio_unload_music(a.bed) } } }` with no close call, while the comment still reads `// audio_destroy — unload the sounds + close the device (app teardown).` Repo-wide grep: zero CloseAudioDevice hits. The 17-wrapper seam has no audio_close_device. raylib 6.0 rcore.c CloseWindow (fetched source) contains only `UnloadFontDefault(); rlglClose(); ClosePlatform();` — it does NOT close the audio device.
detail: Behavior delta introduced by the seam refactor: every non-PP_SW_AUDIO build leaves the initialized audio device open at teardown; the stop-before-unload idiom survived but the device close was dropped, and the comment now misstates the body.
recommended_fix: Add an audio_close_device wrapper (no-op under PP_SW_AUDIO, rl.CloseAudioDevice() otherwise), call it at the end of audio_destroy, and fix the stale comment.

title: N10 still present: nothing in-repo ever sets PP_SW_AUDIO — the seam's SW branch and the gallery app build are unreachable from the repo
evidence: `when #config(PP_SW_AUDIO, false) {` is the only consumer; repo-wide grep (odin/sh/md) finds PP_SW_AUDIO only at app/audio/audio.odin:39,47,257. tools/build_raylib_sw.sh:76 final instruction: `echo "== done. Build the harness with:"` / `ODIN_ROOT=$SHADOW odin build harness` — harness only, no app build, no -define. project-context.md: zero PP_SW_AUDIO/gallery mentions.
detail: Claimed folded (N1-N15) but the producer is still absent: the raylib-sw shadow links no raudio, so the documented gallery app build cannot be re-run from the repo.
recommended_fix: Add the app SW build line (ODIN_ROOT=tools/raylib-sw/shadow odin build app -define:PP_SW_AUDIO=true -define:PP_DEBUG=true) to build_raylib_sw.sh or the gallery doc.

title: Partial fallback-merge failure modes return ok with no refusal and no diagnostic — callers run without the ⚠ glyph
evidence: `fdata, ferr := os.read_entire_file_from_path(fallback_path, context.temp_allocator)` / `if ferr != nil { return glyphs, count // no fallback file — the missing glyphs stay missing }` / `if fg == nil || ng == 0 { return glyphs, count }` — both paths flow to font_atlas_build ok=true, so app:317 / goldens.odin:76 / palcheck.odin:279 all proceed with no U+26A0 slot and no stderr line.
detail: Asymmetric with the fail-loud family fonts: a missing/corrupt/unreadable fallback TTF is also a broken tree, but renders silently. CI's font_warning_glyph_in_merged_atlas pin covers the committed tree only.
recommended_fix: Emit a fmt.eprintfln on the ferr and fg==nil/ng==0 paths (and optionally refuse when the family's only known gap U+26A0 lands in `missing`).

title: font-check swaps only v.font — captured frames render headers and NOC in shipped Plex SemiBold/Mono regardless of candidate
evidence: `old_font := rc.view.font` / `rc.view.font = f` — the only swap; but this PR's surfaces draw through `draw_header_c :: proc(v: ^View, ...) { draw_text_font(v.font_header, ...) }` (crisis/forecast/health/settings/QoS headers) and `draw_mono_c` (the whole NOC panel), which still hold the shipped family during the capture.
detail: The verb's frame capture (step 4) never exercises the candidate on header/mono surfaces — the family split outpaced the A/B tool; its doc claims the candidate is swapped into the render view.
recommended_fix: Also swap rc.view.font_header/font_mono for the capture (restore all three), or note the body-only scope in the verb's header comment.
